profile.headline: Software Developer and part time Sasquatch (maybe)
profile.summary: Results-driven, Customer Oriented IT Professional with experience in software development, product support and hardware support along with extensive Project Management experience. Plus, I'm tall and look like a Sasquatch... which is always a perk. Well, usually.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Once more into the fray. I'm actually still trying to figure out what I do and don't know/remember. I'm leaning towards the latter. It'll all be good. Never count me out.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · JavaScript · Perl · Python (Programming Language) · Software Implementation · Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP)

positions.title: Systems Applications Analyst
positions.description: SQL, Conjuring, Imagineering? Yea, let's go with that. Imagineering sounds Impressive! Disney/NASA... I'm Right Here. Actually no, Imagineering in Health Care sounds Horrible. I'm very practical and astute. Just think MacGyver without the Mac. So, the Gyver, I suppose. That sounds stupid. I don't even know what that is. More like The Guyver which starred Mark Hamill. Now we're talking. It ain't easy being a Jedi but I make do. My wife just shouted "Sith!". *sigh*
positions.insights: Skills: Information Technology · Communication · SQL · Technical Support · Resource Planning

positions.title: Service Support Manager
positions.description: *TWI Acquired by Paymentus in 2014. Somewhere, someone can pay their water bill online... because of ME! *cackle*. Not really, but mostly. Ok, Carl was there too. ENJOY YOUR WATER. That's a subtle nod to SIP, just fyi. Could I interest you in a little dab of Telecom? First one is free...
positions.insights: Skills: Internet Protocol (IP) · Information Technology · Communication · SQL · Technical Support · Resource Planning · Voice over IP (VoIP) · Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) · Telecommunications

positions.title: Client Implementation Manager
positions.description: Long live eVision & UtilityWorks! Small town utility payments via phone, internet, an abstract cow and sometimes whim? You know who you are, Rancho Cucamonga. I don't judge though. But you DID wake me up at 3AM once. Who pays their water bill at 3AM? I mean, really? VXML FTW.
positions.insights: Skills: Internet Protocol (IP) · Information Technology · Communication · SQL · Technical Support · Resource Planning · Voice over IP (VoIP) · Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) · Telecommunications

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Java... are we talking Coffee? I honestly don't recall. That was a lifetime ago. Java development and, well, LotusScript. I know, I feel dirty too. But before this venture I played guitar in a Hair Metal Band! It's always uphill.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Internet Protocol (IP) · Information Technology · JavaScript · Technical Support · Resource Planning · Programming
